trial_court: III Additional Principal Judge, Family Court at Bengaluru, M.C.No.974/2012
case_name: Sri N Ramesh Rao Mane vs Smt Sumathi Bai Sindhe B

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sri N. Ramesh Rao Mane, husband
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Sumathi Bai Sindhe B., wife

facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized on 16.02.2006. The husband filed a petition under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking dissolution of marriage on the ground of cruelty and desertion. The trial court allowed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The court's discretion in awarding maintenance is not unfettered and must be guided by the principles of justice, equity and good conscience.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that the Family Court has failed to consider the evidence on record in its proper perspective...

legal_principles.principle: The court must consider the financial capacity of both parties before awarding maintenance.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that the cross objector-husband has a responsibility to take care of his ailing mother, step mother, and the entire earning of the cross objector-husband is being spent on maintaining the dependants in the joint family.

outcome.final_order: The cross objection is filed to set aside the judgment and decree dated 09.11.2016 passed in M.C.No.974/2012 by which the petition filed by the petitioner-husband was allowed.

use_for_drafting: responding to cross-objections in family court cases
appealing judgments and decrees in family courts
